subcodes.first_line: Say: O my God, my God! I beseech Thee by the ocean of Thy generosity, and by the sun of Thy bounty, and by the heaven of Thy munificence, to ordain for Thy servants that which [3.5s]
subcodes.first_line_orig: قل الهی الهی اسئلک ببحر کرمک و شمس عطائک و سماء جودک بان تقدر لعبادک ما
